Mote bd-01M2SC6N15J2N7PHD4DXBE43VD. Implementation remains owned by codex-eyes4s.

P2: bind complete input evidence before granting VerifiedAdmission.
At io/src/main/scala/eyes4s/io/LedgerReverification.scala:117, the only input comparison is input.hash == replay.accepted.hash, then line 121 returns the supplied input as verified. StudyInput.apply in plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/StudyPlan.scala:221-228 omits dispersionStatus from its fixation hash. A source-imported fixation has Unavailable(NotReported), but replacing it with a public Event.Fixation.of having declared BoundingBoxWidth dispersion 42.0 preserves that hash. The original ledger still passes checkAgainst. The forged input survives the public StudyInputCodecs.study[Px].input encode/decode and still receives Right(VerifiedAdmission), including an admitted input carrying the invented dispersion.

This is a reproducible missing-field binding issue, not a theoretical hash collision or an authenticity claim. The hash omission predates this diff; the new verifier incorrectly relies on that hash as sufficient evidence for the supplied input. Add a complete semantic input comparison/refusal (including dispersion status, value, method and evidence) before constructing verification, with a typed mismatch and this regression. Any broader input digest migration can remain separately scoped.
